chapter: Louis Armstrong picture, Kid Rena record and Bunk
title: Armstrong's book and why Rene dropped the A from the spelling Rena
summary: Rene explains his name is properly Rena and that he dropped the A.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Yeah. That's not a small guy.
Well, Louie always talks about him and his book, you know?
Yeah. You ever seen Louie's book? Louie's book? Mm-hmm.
Eh? I'm sure you're in it.
Yeah? It probably only cost a quart. I'll try to find you one. Okay. Alright, so give me a quart. Give me one. Give me one. I'll charge it to me. You spell your name with two E's now, huh?
Well, you see, I found out that that wasn't Rene. That's Rena. R-E-N-A, Rena. That E said the sound of A. R-E-N-A, Rene. I dropped the A, yeah, yeah.
So you dropped the A, huh? Yeah.

Well, I think I let the A go on because people are so familiar with the A, you know? Yeah. In the jazz. Actually, I had to drop it after. It'd be a little shade, you know? Mm-hmm. But people still know you. They know that name, you know?
